Accepts a block, list of blocks, message/view payload, or explicit string-keyed

list order and Unicode; JSON object key order is unspecified.

A payload for incoming webhooks.

Slack reference: https://docs.slack.dev/messaging/sending-messages-using-incoming-webhooks

## Fields

* `blocks` — Adds the message blocks in display order. Optional; `nil` omits the field.
* `attachments` — Adds legacy attachments in display order. Optional; `nil` omits the field.
* `text` — Sets the fallback text used in notifications and by clients that cannot display blocks. Optional; `nil` omits the field.
* `response_type` — Sets who can see the response. Optional; `nil` omits the field.
* `replace_original` — Sets whether the response replaces the message that triggered it. Optional; `nil` omits the field.
* `delete_original` — Sets whether the response deletes the message that triggered it. Optional; `nil` omits the field.
* `unfurl_links` — Sets whether Slack unfurls text-based links. Optional; `nil` omits the field.
* `unfurl_media` — Sets whether Slack unfurls media links. Optional; `nil` omits the field.
* `metadata` — Sets message metadata as a JSON-compatible map, such as event_type and event_payload. Optional; `nil` omits the field.

@type t() :: %Slackblocks.WebhookMessage{
  attachments: [Slackblocks.Attachment.t()] | nil,
  blocks: [Slackblocks.Types.block()] | nil,
  delete_original: boolean() | nil,
  metadata: %{optional(binary()) => Slackblocks.Types.json()} | nil,
  replace_original: boolean() | nil,
  response_type: Slackblocks.Types.response_type() | nil,
  text: binary() | nil,
  unfurl_links: boolean() | nil,
  unfurl_media: boolean() | nil
}
